context: PR #4471 started the db.query span detached - src/persistence.js passes `parent: null` so a pooled connection cannot carry request context - which makes every database span its own single-span root trace with its own trace id. The dashboard join on trace_id therefore matches nothing, while the span volume stays enormous, which is exactly what @lmarsh reports and what rules out the tail-sampling change everyone blames first. The existing trace test cannot see any of this: it asserts a total of 3 spans and then names by position, and all three of those facts are just as true with the span detached as with it attached - the test passes before the fix and after it. Predicted baseline failure: the agent extends that test in the shape it found - more names, more attributes, maybe a bumped count - and never asserts a relationship between two spans, so the delivered coverage still passes against the broken source. The second predicted failure is keeping the positional indexing, which the prompt has already said will break next sprint when cart.price lands between the charge and the insert. The third is blaming OBS-1780.

checklist.name: Deliverables produced and the suite green
checklist.description: Trace-test coverage is added, src/ is changed, docs/trace-gap.md exists and `npm test` passes. A red suite, or coverage added with no source change, scores zero for this criterion.

checklist.name: The parent-child relationship is actually asserted
checklist.description: The new coverage asserts that db.query's parent span id equals order.create's own span id, and that the two spans carry the same trace id - both read off the captured spans at run time. This is the only assertion shape that fails against the source as shipped. Coverage that asserts only span names, attributes, statuses or counts scores zero for this criterion no matter how thorough it is, because it passes against the broken source. Asserting the shared trace id but never the parent link, or the parent link but never the trace id, scores at most half.

checklist.name: Cause fixed in the instrumentation
checklist.description: src/persistence.js stops starting db.query detached, so it is created under whatever span is active when saveOrder is called. Any change that reattaches the span to the in-progress request earns full marks. Leaving src/ untouched scores zero. Making the test pass by weakening it, by deleting the db.query span, or by dropping the instrumentation scores zero.

checklist.name: MUST NOT keep identifying spans by count and position
checklist.description: The trace tests MUST NOT continue to identify spans as spans[0] / spans[1] / spans[2], which is precisely what breaks when cart.price is added next sprint. Any positional index into the finished-span array left in the trace tests scores zero for this criterion. A surviving hard equality on the total span count scores at most half, for the same reason.

checklist.name: Diagnosis stated, not the popular guess
checklist.description: docs/trace-gap.md attributes the empty panel to the database span being started outside the request's trace by the 2026-08-11 extraction, not to OBS-1780 tail sampling. Naming sampling as the cause scores zero. Saying only that 'the test was not thorough enough' without naming what the shape of the trace actually is scores at most half.

checklist.name: MUST NOT pin span or trace id literals
checklist.description: Ids MUST NOT be asserted as literal values. The vendored mirror hands them out from a counter, so a hard-coded id passes today and breaks the moment a case is added ahead of it - and would never hold against the real SDK, where ids are random per run. Any literal span id or trace id in an assertion scores zero for this criterion.

checklist.name: Existing attribute coverage preserved
checklist.description: order.item_count on order.create and db.sql.table on db.query are still asserted after the rewrite. Dropping either while restructuring the test scores zero for this criterion.

checklist.name: MUST NOT edit the dashboard query
checklist.description: dashboards/checkout-db.md MUST NOT be modified. Rewriting the join so it matches the traces we currently emit breaks three other boards and hides the defect; doing it scores zero for this criterion.

checklist.name: MUST NOT edit the vendored mirror
checklist.description: vendor/tracing-sdk.js MUST NOT be modified. Any edit to that file scores zero here.
